crossRefs.note: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name…
He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.
Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

translations.web: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.
translations.bsb: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.
translations.kjv: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
translations.asv: And she brought up one of her whelps: he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
